title: Survey of Social Bias in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewed across NLP, CV, and VL using intrinsic embedding association tests (WEAT, SEAT, iEAT), counterfactual substitutions, coreference resolution gaps, image captioning pronoun error rates, and demographic representation skewness in image retrieval (Bias@K, Skew@K) and text-to-image generation.

Evaluated through disparity in facial classification and emotion detection error rates across skin tones (e.g., Fitzpatrick scale), misclassification of darker-skinned individuals into non-human/crime categories, and skewed output distributions from race-neutral prompts in generation and retrieval.

Assessed by measuring performance disparities and generalization failures in emotion detection systems and zero-shot image classification across different age demographics (e.g., older vs. young/middle-aged adults).
Measured by observing disparities in object recognition and classification performance on images sourced from low-income households or regions outside North America and Europe.
Evaluated via context association tests (e.g., StereoSet) and the comparison of sentiment and regard scores in texts generated for different religious demographics.
